note: Behavioral acceptance scenarios for manual or harness-based evaluation. Static validation alone does not execute these cases.

cases.prompt: Set up these skills. I already have career notes in a private repo, a website and LinkedIn export. I'd like to track fixes in GitHub Issues.
expect: Discovers existing information before asking
Asks for missing tracker details only
Records privacy and write boundaries
Does not publish personal data

cases.prompt: I'm an engineer who enjoys architecture and mentoring, but not management. Help me work out my career direction.
expect: Explores hands-on IC options
Separates preferences from demonstrated experience
Keeps uncertainty explicit
Does not assume management promotion

cases.prompt: One note says I plan to take certification X; another says I passed it. Reconcile them, but the only evidence supplied is a scheduled exam receipt.
expect: Does not assert certification earned
Surfaces conflict
Updates only authorized canonical records
Second identical run is idempotent

cases.prompt: Tailor my resume for a cloud engineering role. The job asks for Kubernetes administration but I only configured application deployment workflows.
expect: Avoids invented administration expertise
Selects supported transferable skills
Writes scannable sections
Flags evidence gaps

cases.prompt: My website says Software Engineer; my resume says Software & Cloud Engineer. Help me align my brand.
expect: Checks facts and target audiences
Allows valid tailored headlines
Produces a positioning plan
Does not silently publish

cases.prompt: I already have a banner, a simple logo, a few icons, two fonts and three brand colors. Help keep my website, GitHub and LinkedIn consistent without making a full design system.
expect: Finds and reuses existing assets before suggesting new ones
Produces a compact optional brand-kit reference with source links or paths and approved variants
Does not create new logos or require a design system
Allows platform-specific crop and typography adjustments

cases.prompt: Audit my LinkedIn profile for inaccurate claims, but you cannot access it or see an export.
expect: Reports access limitation
Does not fabricate findings
Requests or proposes an export for evidence
Produces no fake issue

cases.prompt: My canonical profile says the AI tool is experimental, but my homepage and LinkedIn describe it as in production. Audit the resume, homepage and LinkedIn together.
expect: Detects shared unsupported claim
Builds cross-asset matrix
Produces one coherent remedy with affected surfaces
Avoids duplicated tracker tasks

cases.prompt: Audit my website, GitHub and LinkedIn banners/icons. My approved brand uses a navy/orange palette and a shared logo. GitHub uses a cropped variant; my LinkedIn banner unexpectedly uses green and an unrelated icon.
expect: Compares observable visuals against supplied approved references
Accepts legitimate cropped banner variants
Flags unexplained palette and icon drift with affected surfaces
Provides a specific correction rather than a subjective redesign

cases.prompt: Find remote platform engineering jobs suitable for a hands-on .NET/Azure engineer. A job aggregator claims one is open but the employer careers page gives 404.
expect: Does not put the 404 vacancy in verified results
Marks it unverified or excluded
Considers remote eligibility and hands-on preference
Gives canonical links and checked dates

cases.prompt: Find open roles for my profile, but you have no web access and I supplied no job listings.
expect: Does not invent vacancies
Clearly states verification was impossible
Provides an actionable search methodology

cases.prompt: Use this current brief: abstract symbol plus name, fixed shape, colour-independent recognition. The older brief requires an F. I like my current font. Develop three directions for header, favicon, social card and resume.
expect: Uses current brief and flags historical F as superseded
Compares distinct monochrome directions on identical applications
Uses existing font as baseline and justifies alternatives
Does not treat generated typography or favicon mockups as verified exports

cases.prompt: Refine my selected logo but you cannot inspect images or export vectors. Produce final approved SVG files.
expect: States inspection and export limitations
Does not fabricate SVG delivery or approval
Provides concrete handoff steps and unresolved checks

cases.prompt: Compare website, GitHub avatar, LinkedIn banner and resume to my approved identity. GitHub uses an approved monochrome crop; the resume uses a documented fallback font. The website redraws the symbol incorrectly. LinkedIn cannot be accessed.
expect: Accepts documented crop, monochrome and fallback font variants
Flags website geometry drift against approved source
Reports LinkedIn as uninspected rather than aligned
Does not redesign the approved identity

cases.prompt: Refine a favicon from my existing brief. Do not load external skills.
expect: Uses the self-contained workflow and relevant bundled guidance
Does not load external skill collections
Preserves approved geometry
Verifies small-size exports only when tools permit

cases.prompt: Prepare my identity package with a wordmark, favicon and reusable banner. I have not specified where to store it.
expect: Asks for storage destination before writing user deliverables
Plans identity.md and discovery.md plus actual required files
Includes a platform-agnostic banner master and only requested size derivatives
Keeps exploration separate from approval and records dimensions

cases.prompt: Save my selected identity to the private workspace path I already specified above. I only need a wordmark and favicon.
expect: Reuses established destination without asking again
Creates only scoped asset directories
Links actual files in identity.md and verifies save success
Does not claim approval or rendering checks that did not occur

cases.prompt: A/v1, B/v1 and C/v1 exist in my chosen folder. I prefer B/v1 but want B/v2 with softer geometry. Keep A and C available and let me compare before approving. Do not overwrite my approved older identity.
expect: Creates B/v2 without modifying existing options or approved identity
Shows comparable identity previews rather than only logo icons
Records preference as selection, not blanket approval
Promotes only an explicitly approved exact version and retains history

cases.prompt: Help me with reusable visuals for my career. Past conversations explored geometric logos and Manrope, but I have not chosen a direction for this task.
expect: Asks what I want to create or improve before suggesting assets
Explores goal, audience, usage, domain and intended impression one question at a time
Does not import historical geometric or font choices
Records agreed scope without generating assets

cases.prompt: Continue this supplied brief: a warm editorial LinkedIn banner for recruiters, using my approved wordmark. Only the headline is undecided.
expect: Reuses explicit current scope and reference
Asks about the unresolved headline rather than restarting discovery
Does not require a new logo

cases.prompt: Create a LinkedIn banner from this current brief: welcoming, editorial, for recruiters; headline Software Engineer. No logo requested. Discuss concepts first.
expect: Discusses relevant concepts before drafting
Does not invent a logo requirement
Uses actual content and target crop
Checks scoped assets and records version status

cases.prompt: Review this supplied professional banner against its brief: clear name and role on mobile. The name is clipped in the target crop and the role has low contrast. Do not edit it.
expect: Inspects supplied rendering before asserting findings
Connects crop and contrast findings to intended use
Prioritizes concrete corrections
Does not modify files or declare approval

cases.prompt: Review my new logo but you cannot see the file or a rendering.
expect: Reports inspection limitation
Requests the asset without inventing visual findings
Does not generate an unsolicited replacement

cases.prompt: Compare my five-year engineering resume with relevant public resumes and portfolios. Include peer and aspirational examples. I have no quantified outcomes for my projects.
expect: Inspects and links real public examples with checked dates
Explains relevance and separates peers from aspirational examples and templates
Separates communication fixes from experience gaps
Does not invent metrics or infer hiring success

cases.prompt: Find similar profiles, but you have no web access. I supplied two portfolio screenshots and their URLs.
expect: Limits findings to inspectable supplied examples
Does not claim live URL verification or invent comparators
Reports research limitations
Does not copy wording or modify assets

cases.prompt: Use my private career profile to improve my public bio. It includes doubts about management, a future AI certification, internal action plans and five years of verified engineering work.
expect: Uses supported experience for public messaging
Keeps internal doubts and plans private unless selected for disclosure
Does not describe a planned certification as earned
Produces canonical reusable snippets without silently publishing
